title: Pull requests wait for Copilot's review inside ci-ok; Dependabot's holds only its own commits
assertion: In the `swerepo-ci.yml` that `swerepo init` writes when the ruleset requests Copilot's review (also when github is applied on its own after ci), `ci-ok` waits for a `copilot-review` job that runs on pull requests only and whose `permissions:` block grants `pull-requests: read` and nothing else, and the `pull_request` trigger lists `types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]`, so a draft marked ready runs again. Run as written, with the values its own `env:` block maps from GitHub (`GH_TOKEN`, the pull request's author and its branch's repository included; the fake `gh` refuses without the token), the job asks GitHub for exactly `repos/<repository>/pulls/<number>/reviews` with `--paginate`. It passes once that list holds a review by `copilot-pull-request-reviewer[bot]`, asking again when the first answer has none. It fails when none comes or only others reviewed (look-alike names included). A draft fails at once, without asking, whoever opened it, Dependabot included. A pull request opened by `dependabot[bot]` passes at once, without asking for reviews, when its branch is in this repository and every commit on it (`repos/<repository>/pulls/<number>/commits`, `--paginate`) is authored by Dependabot, verified, and committed by GitHub itself (`web-flow`), so a commit in Dependabot's name signed with someone else's key doesn't pass. Any other Dependabot pull request fails at once, even with Copilot's review in, without pausing or asking for reviews: one with another author's commit, one linked to no account, an unverified commit, a commit with another committer or none, one from a fork, or one with no commits listed. Changes by people or agents go in a pull request of their own. Every other author waits, asking for reviews exactly 40 times with a pause after each, and fails without a review: people, look-alike names (`dependabot`, `dependabotb`, `dependabot[bot]x`, `xdependabot[bot]`), and other bots, Renovate and a coding agent included. `ci-ok`'s step fails on a pull request whose `copilot-review` didn't succeed, and on a push where it ran. With `--no-copilot-review` (also on a later run that turns the wait off) or a committed ruleset without Copilot review, there is no such job.

origin.text: Replaces inv_faa5bef5 (ADR-20261123-a359) after Dependabot's first pull requests (#12–#14) were all blocked: GitHub requests Copilot's review only for authors who have Copilot, so the wait timed out on every dependency update. The owner's decision (ADR-20261123-cc8d): Dependabot's pull requests don't wait; their tests and dependency-review still run and the person who merges reviews them. Everything else inv_faa5bef5 locked is kept word for word. Tightened after Gemini's review (DB-F01, DB-F03), the owner, and SeamSpec's reviewer: a Dependabot pull request holds only Dependabot's commits, committed by GitHub itself (web-flow, as on its real PRs #12–#14), on a branch in the repository, and anything else fails at once; drafts are decided first; Renovate isn't exempt, since its commits carry no signature GitHub vouches for; the wait is pinned at exactly 40 asks.

status_reason: ADR-20261126-c228 (review P8-C, the owner's go-ahead 2026-11-26): the pull request that adds SWERepo waited 20 minutes for a Copilot review nothing requested, since GitHub requests it only through an active ruleset rule and the ruleset is applied after that pull request merges. The job now reads the default branch's rules once (DEFAULT_BRANCH and PRIVATE through env:) and passes when no copilot_code_review rule is there, or on GitHub Free's 403 on a private repository; any other failed read fails. inv_78f19f51's test fails because it doesn't know the two new env: values, and its sentence "every other author waits" is no longer true where nothing requests Copilot. inv_b5d32550 keeps every one of its checks and adds the rules read.
